name: Volskaya Foundry
theme: Capture Control Points to summon and pilot a two-seat Triglav Protector mech.
firstObjective: Warning at 2:00, spawns at 2:30 (~2:00 cooldown after the Triglav Protector is destroyed or expires)
spawnPattern: 3 fixed Control Points (Top, Mid & Bottom); rotates across points in a set cycle

mechanic.title: Control Points & Triglav Protector
mechanic.description: Stand uncontested inside the active Control Point to charge capture progress to 100%, entering Overtime if contested near completion. The winning team summons a two-seat Triglav Protector mech—split between a Driver (handling movement, melee attacks, charges, and defensive shields) and a Gunner (operating long-range weapons and artillery)—that scales in strength over the match.

camps.name: Support Camp / Healing Pulse (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper and lower jungle areas. Drops a collectible Healing Pulse item that creates a large AoE healing zone for nearby allies during prolonged point contests.

camps.name: Fortification Camp / Turret (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the side alcoves. Drops a collectible Turret item that fires automatically at nearby enemies and structures.

camps.name: Siege / Rocket Troopers (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the outer lanes. Fires long-range rockets down lanes; easy to clear ahead of Control Point activations.

strategy: Volskaya Foundry has no Boss camp and revolves around sustained teamfights over Control Points and conveyor-belt rotations that often stretch into Overtime. Heroes with strong zone control, poke, and sustain (such as Junkrat, Chromie, Blaze, and Lucio) excel here; grab Healing Pulse and Turret camps right before objectives spawn to drop them on the point, and put a durable frontline hero in the Driver seat while a ranged damage dealer or support takes the Gunner seat.
notes: Conveyor belts speed up movement along their direction and can catch unwary heroes during teamfights or escapes—use them to rotate faster between lanes and objectives, and coordinate Driver positioning with Gunner targeting so the Triglav Protector stays safe while sieging.
